answer.rationale: The diagnosed deficits are funnel-mechanical (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%), so the highest-leverage single slot is repairing the funnel rather than reacting to the competitor's price move. memory_73 explicitly records that aggressive discounting bought signups and short-term revenue while costing 12pp of early retention, which is disqualifying against a sustainable-qualified-revenue objective, so promotional_pricing is ruled out even though it is the most direct answer to the competitive pressure. enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) addresses a segment that is not the one bleeding. Between the two funnel options, memory_86 (onboarding shortening lifted completion and time-to-value) maps more directly onto the declining metric than memory_91, whose claim is vaguely worded ('nudged more accounts') and therefore weakly load-bearing; simplify_onboarding also sits upstream of activation, so a completion lift should partially propagate into the activation number. I am spending verification on memory_86 because it is the single memory my choice rests on, and on memory_57 because referral_incentive is the only inherited result stated in qualified-revenue terms rather than proxy metrics — it is the alternative that would actually displace my choice if the onboarding record turns out thin. I am deliberately not verifying memory_31: it corroborates memory_86 but is day-12 vintage and largely redundant, so its marginal information is low. Key caveat I am carrying forward rather than resolving: every onboarding/activation memory measures proxies (completion, first-week activation, early adoption), not downstream qualified revenue or retention. memory_31 specifically achieved its lift by cutting required signup fields, which is exactly the kind of change that can raise activation counts while degrading lead qualification and downstream revenue quality — the same shape of failure memory_73 documents. So I will instrument this experiment on qualified-revenue and 30/60-day retention, not just completion rate, and treat a completion lift with flat or worse qualified revenue as a negative result. Standard experiment scale rather than broad rollout because the supporting evidence is proxy-grade and the competitive regime has shifted since these records were consolidated; standard rather than small-guarded because the change is reversible and low-harm.
